title: DeliveryAttempt
description: One attempt to hand a completion receipt to the parent. An attempt never leaves held_uncertain because time passed; only affirmative evidence moves it. Contradictory safety states are refused by the allOf invariants below, not left to prose.

requestId.description: del- + first 12 hex of eventId + -a<attemptNo>. Stable within an attempt so an uncertain send is reconciled, never duplicated.

recipientTaskId.description: Must equal the relationship's registered parent taskId. A recipient outside the registry is refused before any transport call.

deliveryState.description: dispatched means turn/start returned a turn id; it is not acknowledgement and not verification. No state is reachable by timeout alone.

recipientStatusBefore.description: Read immediately before the send. Point-in-time and possibly stale by the next instant.

recipientApprovalPolicy.description: Verbatim from the transport receipt's resumed.approvalPolicy. Any value other than 'never' closes the push channel, so this is what distinguishes an inbox_only fallback from a push never attempted.

sendAttempted.description: Whether turn/start was actually reached. 'no' requires a COMPLETED failure receipt attributable to an operation before turn/start. An unfinished receipt (in_progress_or_unknown) is always 'unknown', because the bridge persists a receipt before its RPCs run and that snapshot legitimately lacks 'resumed' while the operation may still reach turn/start.

failedOperation.description: Recovered from the receipt: rpcError.code plus the method prefix of receipt.error, which renders as '<method>: <message>'. connect() runs inside every call, so an initialize failure is reachable even after resume succeeded. Anything not matched maps to 'unclassified' and is treated conservatively as uncertain.

turnId.description: Present only when the transport returned a started turn.

retrySafe.description: True only for a completed, attributable pre-send rejection. Never true for an uncertain, unknown or unfinished outcome, regardless of elapsed time.

reconciliation.description: Required before any further send once deliveryState is held_uncertain. Fixed order: operation receipt first, then the recipient's exact actual turns.

affirmativeEvidence.description: none keeps the attempt held; it never licenses a new attempt.

failedOperation.description: retrySafe is only meaningful when a specific pre-send operation refused. turn/start, transport, initialize, unclassified and null can never justify it.
